extracted.intended_audience: D.C. Bar members, Washington, D.C. lawyers, policymakers, and members of the public interested in the Bar's public statements and comments
extracted.subtask_description: An archival listing of public statements, comments, and position papers issued or cosponsored by the D.C. Bar's Public Interest and Courts community, with dates and titles and occasional notes about full text availability. The page serves as an index rather than guidance on drafting comments.
